newsitem.title: USA: Physician says Sierra balks at terms.
newsitem.headline: Physician says Sierra balks at terms.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said on Thursday that Sierra Health Services Inc told Physician it is unwilling to continue merger discussions under the current terms.

Physician Corp added, however, that both companies were willing to proceed with their discussions under renegotiated terms. An announcement about the status of the proposed merger is expected to be made by March 31.
Physician also said it won a new 145,000-member, two-year contract in southeast Puerto Rico, and a two-year renewal contract in the island's central region with 265,000 members.
Physician Corp provides health-care services in Florida, Texas and Puerto Rico.
